name: Seiheki Touron ~The Final Chapter~
source: The final installment of the 'Seiheki Touron' series. The story revolves around a one-on-one debate format where participants argue based on specific sexual topics to win the favor of an audience. The event takes place in an underground facility accessible only via connection and high-value tickets. The protagonist, Ibar Mizuki, has reigned as the organizer for two years but now steps into the role of a participant to find someone suitable to train her own body. The game features a real-time debate system and 'Consideration Collection' phases where the player must influence audience opinion.
translation: “Seiheki Touron”系列的最后一部分。故事围绕一对一的辩论形式展开，参与者根据特定的性话题进行辩论，以赢得观众的青睐。该活动在地下设施中举行，只能通过转机和高价门票进入。主人公伊巴尔·水树作为组织者统治了两年，现在却以参与者的身份寻找适合自己锻炼身体的人。该游戏具有实时辩论系统和“考虑收集”阶段，玩家必须影响观众的意见。
